title: Snowbird Technologies Manufactures Stainless Steel Parts Aboard USS Essex During RIMPAC 2026
summary: Snowbird Technologies successfully manufactured and machined a 316L stainless steel component aboard the USS Essex during Rim of the Pacific Exercise 2026 (RIMPAC 2026). This demonstration showcased expeditionary manufacturing capabilities in an operational maritime environment. The achievement highlights the potential for on-demand parts production at sea.

title: Army picks Hanwha’s wheeled K9 for self-propelled howitzer prototypes
summary: The U.S. Army has selected Hanwha's wheeled K9 system for its self-propelled howitzer prototypes. This decision follows decades of previous attempts to find a new mobile howitzer, including projects like the Crusader and Non-Line-of-Sight Cannon. The selection marks a significant step in modernizing the Army's artillery.

title: Striveworks to build AI layer for NGC2 at corps level, Army says
summary: Striveworks will develop an Artificial Intelligence (AI) layer for the U.S. Army's Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) system at the corps level. This AI integration aims to significantly reduce staff work, potentially compressing hours of tasks into seconds. The initiative seeks to enhance decision-making and operational efficiency through advanced AI models.

title: New Details Emerge About Ukraine’s Homegrown “Equalizer” Glide Bomb
summary: New information has surfaced regarding Ukraine's domestically developed "Equalizer" glide bomb. Ukraine is relying on this weapon to provide an affordable, air-launched standoff capability, reducing dependence on foreign donors. The Equalizer aims to bolster Ukraine's indigenous long-range strike options.

title: EA-37B Flew Along Kaliningrad Border As Part Of “Specialized” Recon, EW Flight Package
summary: The U.S. Air Force's new EA-37B Compass Call electronic warfare jet participated in a specialized reconnaissance and EW flight package. This mission occurred along the border of Russia's strategic military outpost in Kaliningrad, as part of a larger NATO operation. The flight demonstrates the operational deployment of the new EW aircraft in a sensitive region.

title: World-first eVTOL vertiport gets the green light
summary: Ever been stuck in traffic and wished you could simply fly above it all, straight to your destination? Well, that dream is one step closer to reality, as the world's first airport for flying taxis has just received the regulatory green light. Continue Reading Category: Aircraft , Transport Tags: eVTOL , urban …
detail: The world's first dedicated vertiport, an airport for electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft or 'flying taxis,' has received regulatory approval. This development marks a significant step towards realizing urban air mobility (UAM), where eVTOLs could offer an alternative to ground transportation congestion. Regulatory approval is crucial for establishing the necessary infrastructure, safety standards, and operational frameworks that will allow these advanced air vehicles to integrate into urban environments. It signals a shift from purely conceptual designs and aircraft development to the practical implementation of an entire ecosystem required for future air travel services. Companies are actively developing eVTOL aircraft, and the approval of facilities like this vertiport is essential for their eventual commercial deployment, paving the way for a new era of short-distance, on-demand air travel.

title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
summary: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.
detail: Google has introduced new AI-powered study tools integrated into its Search engine and Gemini AI assistant. This strategic move aims to position Gemini as a leading AI assistant for students, enhancing its utility beyond general information retrieval to specific educational applications. By embedding these features, Google seeks to deepen its presence in the learning and studying sector, directly competing with other major AI developers like OpenAI, which are also exploring educational uses for their large language models. The new tools leverage Google's extensive data and AI capabilities to offer functionalities such as explaining complex topics, generating practice questions, and summarizing study materials, thereby providing a more comprehensive and personalized learning experience for users.

title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
summary: A competition is developing between OpenAI and Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data.
detail: OpenAI is enhancing its customer privacy protections for enterprise clients, a move that reflects growing competition with companies like Anthropic over data security. As businesses increasingly adopt AI solutions, the handling of sensitive proprietary data becomes a critical concern. By offering robust privacy features, AI providers aim to build trust and attract enterprise customers who require assurances that their confidential information will not be misused, such as for training future AI models without consent. This competitive drive towards stronger data governance and security protocols signifies a maturing AI market where differentiation extends beyond just the performance of AI models to include comprehensive data protection and ethical considerations, which are paramount for widespread business adoption.

title: Travis Kalanick kicks off another round of VC bashing: ‘1% are helpful’
summary: After raising $1.7 billion for his new robotics company Atoms, Travis Kalanick is introspective about the role VCs have played in his career.
detail: Travis Kalanick, co-founder of Uber and current head of robotics company Atoms, has publicly criticized venture capitalists (VCs), stating that only a small percentage are genuinely helpful. These comments, made after his company successfully raised $1.7 billion, highlight an ongoing debate within the startup ecosystem regarding the true value and role of VCs. Kalanick's perspective, likely informed by his extensive experience, including past conflicts with investors at Uber, underscores the tension between founders seeking strategic partnership and VCs primarily focused on financial returns. His remarks prompt a discussion about the quality of mentorship, strategic advice, and operational support VCs provide beyond capital, questioning whether their involvement consistently adds substantive value to entrepreneurial ventures.

title: Rillet raises $100M Series C at $1B valuation — 2 years after emerging from stealth
summary: AI-native account startup Rillet became a unicorn, led by Iconiq, after it doubled its ARR in the past three months, it said.
detail: Rillet, an AI-native account startup, has successfully raised $100 million in Series C funding, achieving a valuation of $1 billion and thus 'unicorn' status. This rapid ascent occurred just two years after the company emerged from stealth mode, driven by a doubling of its Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in the past three months. This significant investment and valuation underscore strong investor confidence in Rillet's business model and the burgeoning market demand for AI-native solutions, particularly within the enterprise sector. Achieving unicorn status quickly signals robust growth, effective market penetration, and the successful application of innovative technology, further highlighting the continued strong investment landscape for promising artificial intelligence companies.

title: Sweden’s H100 reports $26M H1 loss driven by falling Bitcoin value
summary: Sweden’s H100 reported a $26 million loss for the first half of the year, as it completed its acquisitions to become Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury by holdings.

title: Winklevoss-Backed Cypherpunk Launches 'World's Largest' Zcash Mining Fleet
summary: The Nasdaq-listed privacy firm launched Cypherpunk Mining through a $33.33 million equity deal with Winklevoss Capital, adding roughly 18% of the Zcash network's hashrate to accelerate its treasury ambitions.

title: Bitcoin.com integrates UAE-registered US dollar stablecoin into self-custodial wallet
summary: The integration expands access to USDU, the UAE’s first central bank-registered US dollar stablecoin, as it builds distribution beyond institutional channels.

title: Moderna Stock Doubles on Cancer Breakthrough: Here’s What It Means
summary: A Phase 3 win against the standard of care sent the biotech's shares up 131% and left short sellers down $4.8 billion.

title: StanChart, HSBC execute first live transaction on Swift blockchain ledger
summary: The transaction connected the banks’ separate tokenized deposit systems through Swift’s ledger, marking a step toward interoperable, 24/7 cross-border payments.
